BD-CN.notes: Bangladesh Bank outward student remittance regulations apply. Transactions exceeding the daily cap (500,000 BDT) must be split into multiple compliant tranches.

IN-GB.notes: Reserve Bank of India LRS (Liberalised Remittance Scheme) guidelines apply. TCS applies above 700,000 INR; PAN card and Form A2 declaration required.

PH-AE.notes: Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) remittance rules apply. Beneficiary IBAN/routing code and mobile wallet verification required.
